Single-tag preview, actual size:
Prints one page per front-page (same page count, same tag grid) so you can print the fronts, flip the whole stack over, and run it through again for the backs. If your printer has automatic duplex, use "flip on long edge" / "flip on short edge" in its print dialog and toggle "Rotate 180°" above if the backs come out upside-down.
Tag size is fixed by the page geometry: 8.5″ page − 0.10″ left/right margins ÷ 2 columns = 4.15″ wide; 11″ page − 0.25″ top/bottom margins ÷ 10 rows = 1.05″ tall. Barcodes are Code128, generated from the SKU column. Everything runs locally in your browser — no file is uploaded anywhere.
